resources.string: Configure your baseline chain wax life. The calculator sets an absolute maximum distance depending on the specific wax blend you apply, and then scales that distance down for heavier riders who generate more drivetrain wear.
Set Wax Life by Rider Weight (kg)
When your chain\'s remaining life falls below this percentage, it will turn red in the app and you will receive a notification to remind you to rewax.
This base wax life is automatically calculated based on the Wax Type and Rider Weight above, but you can manually override it here if you prefer a custom baseline distance.

The app automatically discovers your Karoo Activity Profiles as you start rides. Assign the correct Surface Type below to adjust your wear multipliers (e.g., Gravel riding removes more wax life per kilometer than Road riding).
Did you rewax this chain? This will reset the remaining distance to %1$s.
Did you ride in the rain? This will instantly cut your remaining wax life in half.
